relevant_laws.quote: No pedestrian shall cross a roadway at any place other than by a route at right angles to the curb or by the shortest route to the opposite curb except in a crosswalk.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: conditional roadway crossing route and crosswalk exception
relevant_laws.notes: The authored road and conditional witness do not establish a sourced roadway, curbs, crosswalk boundaries or municipal jurisdiction.
